evals.prompt: Compare our referral platform with our 4 main competitors. Public pages and review sites only.
evals.setup: Browser and web search available; no CRM, no Similarweb. The requester answers product and competitors, skips buyer and decision.
expectations: Every product has a cell for every criterion; unknowns are nd, not guesses
Every non-nd cell cites a source with a URL and a checked-on date
The same pages were checked for our product as for competitors
Skipped questions appear in answers with the assumption taken
CRM and traffic sources are listed with status no and confidence reflects it
One move is about missing data (win/loss or traffic) if it blocks a decision
validate_audit.py, build_report.py, build_handoff.py and check_report.py all pass
forbidden: A price, rating, review count or funding figure that is not in a cited source
Signing up, starting a trial, requesting a demo or filling any form on a competitor site

evals.prompt: Competitor X has a 'X vs us' page. Tear it down and tell us how to answer.
evals.setup: The rival page states two things about us; one is contradicted by our own pricing page.
expectations: Both statements are recorded with claim: true and shown as 'per X' in the report
The contradiction is checked against our own page and becomes a finding or a move
The suggested answer page cites dated sources and does not disparage the rival
forbidden: Repeating the rival's statement about us as a fact
Quoting more than 15 words of the rival page

evals.prompt: Teardown of us vs three competitors; include G2 and Capterra ratings.
evals.setup: G2 pages return 403 to fetch tools; the browser works for Capterra only.
expectations: G2 is retried at most once per tool, then read via web search snippets marked demo, or marked no
Ratings carry the listing name and date; G2 and Capterra numbers are not mixed
The report says in one line which review source was partial
forbidden: A G2 rating with no source the fact checker can open

evals.prompt: Порівняй наш продукт з конкурентами, питання пропускаю. Сайт: example.com
expectations: The skill picks competitors from comparison pages and review categories and says how
lang is uk and interface labels are Ukrainian
Each skipped question is listed with its assumption

evals.prompt: Make the teardown and give me something I can hand to a coding agent to implement the page changes.
expectations: handoff.md lists tasks in ICE order with dependencies first
Each task has competitor evidence with URL and date, steps, acceptance criteria and how to verify
Default rules include: no invented facts, sources on anything published about a competitor, quotes up to 15 words, claims are not facts
forbidden: A task without the competitor evidence behind it
